finalText:
It's building clean now, exit 0.

The wall of noise was mostly harmless deprecation warnings from the bump, but two spots had real bugs from an options-shape change:

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Undefined `.toFixed()` was crashing the link step.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated an unset backoff flag as an error instead of a default `false`, since the new config loader leaves it `undefined` rather than `false`.

Fixed both. Build now finishes with 8 warnings, 0 errors — the rest really is just noise from the dependency bump.
